name: Heat and Mass Transport in Fibrous Materials
description: Newtonian and non-newtonian fluid: viscosity, Reynolds number, Bernoulli equation, fluid flow through pipe; thermal conduction through fibrous media. Fourier’s law, thermal conductivity, steady state heat conduction, effective thermal conductivity for fibrous materials; convective heat transfer through fibrous media. The concept of heat transfer coefficient, macroscopic equations governing heat and mass transfer in textile material, generalized Darcy’s law, mass and energy conservation, thermodynamic relations. Surface tension: wetting and wicking in a fibrous material. Moisture diffusion. Estimation of ventilation rate. Heat and moisture transport in clothing by ventilation. Phase change in textile- moisture condensation and evaporation. Air filtration using fibrous media-fibre size effect, SFFE.
